rationale: Splunk Enterprise is AI-positive: Splunk's official feature documentation describes AI Toolkit machine-learning analytics and custom model development, and official MLTK documentation says the core platform search has machine-learning capabilities integrated in SPL. The core product remains a broad search, data management, monitoring, and visualization platform without the AI capabilities, so AI-enabled is the best-supported type.
ai_type_rationale: The documented AI toolkit extends a conventional enterprise search/analytics platform; its core observability and visualization offering remains meaningful without machine learning.
version_scope: Record names Splunk Enterprise but provides no release/version. Official product feature and toolkit pages describe current offering; historical availability of integrated ML is not established, though the product documentation directly identifies the platform feature.
issues: Current official functionality pages do not date the source-record release; historical feature availability may differ.

sources.applicability: Official Splunk Enterprise feature page explicitly presents AI/ML capabilities for the product platform.

sources.excerpt: The Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit (MLTK) is an app available for both Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud Platform users through Splunkbase. ... Core Platform Search: The Splunk platform has machine learning capabilities integrated in the SPL.
sources.applicability: Official docs distinguish the separately available MLTK app from machine-learning capabilities integrated in the platform; supports product-level AI and optionality distinction.
